adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 source re-review replaced the framework-test stop state with source-reviewed final adjudication: Table 1 MIC values were rebuilt by peptide/nanoconjugate entity, linked database rows were reconciled or preserved as explicit source_conflict cautions, mechanism claims were bounded to direct assay and computational evidence classes, and the original rework ticket was closed with no open publication-blocking target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Database rows carry exact hemolysis percentages, while local primary XML/PDF expose the hemolysis assay and Figure 1D but no machine-readable numeric hemolysis table. These rows remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.

Linked database rows use a Typhimurium ATCC label in places where the primary source labels the Table 1 organism as S. typhi. Activity values are preserved with source locators and the naming conflict remains explicit.
Two CAMP rows have title/name labels that do not align with the Table 1 MIC pattern; they are retained as source_conflict instead of being silently normalized.

The article table labels the organism as S. typhi while linked database rows use a Typhimurium ATCC label. Final activity rows preserve the article label and database audit records the conflict context.
Figure 2 supports membrane leakage and in-cell NMR context, but exact plotted time-course/leakage values are not available as source tables in local material.

The packet has 10 supplementary .bin assets, but local file typing and supplementary_text indexing show HTML landing pages rather than recoverable XLSX/PDF supplementary tables. XML/PDF Table 1 and figure captions were sufficient for the owner-layer repair.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded worker-4/6 re-review opened primary XML/PDF, packet-extracted PDF text/figure captions, supplementary index/text entries, HTML landing-page supplementary assets, and all linked database JSONL rows. Remaining limitations are source-conflict cautions, not open rework blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Primary XML methods verify AY1, AY1C, and CAY1 sequences plus AgNP conjugation context; Table 1 supports the MIC matrix. Hemolysis exact percentages, Salmonella taxon-label differences, and two CAMP name/value mismatches remain explicit source_conflict cautions rather than hidden normalization.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows now preserve all Table 1 peptide/nanoconjugate MIC cells with entity names, raw values, units, targets, and locators. NA cells are represented as not_active_up_to_100 based on the MIC method range.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct mechanism evidence is limited to in-cell NMR, fluorescence dye-leakage, and SEM cell-disruption assays, with MD pore formation recorded separately as computational support.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_gate: The previous framework-test-only blocker is resolved because the owner layers were source-reviewed from local material; remaining source conflicts are caution findings and no open rework target remains.
